cases.question:
按下单时间 [2018-07-01,2018-08-01) 的已交付订单，限定至少有一条支付记录，统计商品含运费总金额。每行只返回[金额]，金额保留两位。
这是给定候选查询的受控修复流程。第一次 sql_query 调用必须按原样执行下面候选 SQL，然后根据工具反馈完成统计，不得更换业务口径。
候选 SQL：
SELECT SUM(i.price+i.freight_value) FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN olist_order_payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01'
cases.required_first_sql: SELECT SUM(i.price+i.freight_value) FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN olist_order_payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01'
cases.reference_sql: WITH i AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(price) product,SUM(freight_value) freight FROM olist_order_items GROUP BY order_id), p AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(payment_value) payment FROM olist_order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(i.product+i.freight) FROM olist_orders o JOIN i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN p ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01'

cases.question:
按下单时间 [2018-07-01,2018-08-01) 的已交付订单，限定至少有一条商品记录，统计支付总金额。每行只返回[金额]，金额保留两位。
这是给定候选查询的受控修复流程。第一次 sql_query 调用必须按原样执行下面候选 SQL，然后根据工具反馈完成统计，不得更换业务口径。
候选 SQL：
SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN olist_order_payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01'
cases.required_first_sql: SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN olist_order_payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM olist_order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id)

cases.question: 按下单时间 [2018-07-01,2018-08-01) 的已交付订单，限定同时有商品记录和支付记录，统计商品金额（不含运费）与支付总额。每行依次返回[商品金额,支付金额]，金额保留两位。
cases.reference_sql: WITH i AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(price) product,SUM(freight_value) freight FROM olist_order_items GROUP BY order_id), p AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(payment_value) payment FROM olist_order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(i.product),SUM(p.payment) FROM olist_orders o JOIN i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN p ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2018-08-01'
